note: One table for deploy.rs's keep and deploy.ts's checkDeploy: `refused` is the line both must say, null keeps the value. A url case is named app; a url_name case names https://app.example.com. An env case is named prod; an env_name case is tagged prod-*.

cases.refused: url app = "https://" is not an http(s) address
url app = "https://a b" is not an http(s) address
url app = "javascript:alert(1)" is not an http(s) address
url app = "file:///etc/passwd" is not an http(s) address
url name "host:disk" may not hold ':'
url name "cert:" may not hold ':'
version_url = "ftp://v.example" is not an http(s) address
host = "-oProxyCommand=x" is not an ssh alias or host name
host = "two words" is not an ssh alias or host name
compose service "--all" is not a name
compose service "two words" is not a name
sentry = "acme" is not org/project
sentry = "a/b/c" is not org/project
sentry = "-a/b" is not org/project
sentry = "acme/" is not org/project
envs.prod = "v[0-9]*" is not a tag glob: * is its only wildcard
envs.prod = "-x" is not a tag glob: * is its only wildcard
envs.prod = "a b" is not a tag glob: * is its only wildcard
env "" is not a name
env "ab" is not a name
